meta.comment: feat.factorytypes (FEAT-105, §33/§46/§17/§34) — the factory-unit catalogue: every manufacturing type as a DISTINCT modelled facility (assembler, steel mill, electronics, chemicals converter, food processing, textiles, cement, glass), each with its own footprint, input-output pair, jobs, utility draw and blight class. This is a data contract consumed by internal/engine/freight (GR#15): every per-type figure lives here, never as a Go literal in internal/engine/freight/*.go.
meta.unitConvention: Per-type field units, stated explicitly for a future editor: footprintCells is in CELLS (a siting footprint, §34); inputs/outputs tonnePerDay are in TONNES per day (matching §33's tonnes/day end-to-end and data/freight.json); jobs is a headcount (the staff a chain-stage firm hires against, §45); powerKWhPerDay is in kWh per day and waterLitresPerDay is in litres per day (the §17 producer-coefficient utility draw, matching data/freight.json's powerKWhPerDay/waterLitresPerDay); blightClass is an ordinal in the documented §32/§34 enum (0=none, 1=low, 2=light, 3=moderate, 4=heavy, 5=severe).
meta.singleSourceOfTruth: The input-output/jobs/utility/blight values are OWNED BY data/freight.json's chain stages, never duplicated here (GR#3, AC-5). A factory type that corresponds to a §33 chain stage carries ONLY a 'stageRef' naming that stage (steelMill↔steelMill, cement↔cementPlant, foodProcessing↔flourMill), and the resolver re-exports the stage's input-output/jobs/power/water/blight by reference through one code path — there is no second editable copy, so a future balance edit to data/freight.json flows to the factory type automatically. Footprint (cells) is facility-level and lives HERE for every type, because data/freight.json stages carry no footprint. The five types with no §33 chain stage (assembler, electronics, chemicals converter, textiles, glass) carry their input-output/jobs/power/water/blight inline here, since there is no freight stage to reference. A stageRef entry that ALSO carries inline input-output/jobs/power/water/blight is rejected at load time.
meta.balanceNote: Every per-type figure in this file is a COARSE PLACEHOLDER pending Aaron's balance pass (ASM-683) — directional only, chosen to exercise the distinct-facility model. The §33 modal caps and §46 archetype character (utility boss-fight, blight-class-high) are carried as per-type direction, not a final magnitude.
meta.buildingsBoundary: data/buildings.json (FEAT-010) holds buildable manufacturing/FDI-anchor entries (semiconductor fab, chemicals complex, steel process plant, EV gigafactory) with unlock/cost/capacity. THIS file holds only the simulation parameters. A future build entry must reference a factory-type key and never re-declare these numbers (ASM-694).
